gen.title: How many states must ratify an amendment

stages.quote: A proposed amendment becomes part of the Constitution as soon as it is ratified by three-fourths of the States (38 of 50 States).

checks.message: every threshold title, stage id, body, scenario id and label shape is within the frozen limits
all 2 stage quote(s) (rule quote and total quote) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)
every stage total occurs as a whole number in its totalQuote, so the page states the size of each voting body (total-in-quote)
every stage quote states its rule in the page's own words: "majority", a whole fraction spelling ("two-thirds", "three-fourths", …), or the stated count as a whole number (rule-in-quote)
every page-stated required count equals the count our engine computes from the rule (stages[0]: 38 = three-fourths of 50) (stated-count-consistent)

every scenario holds one distinct integer yes count per stage, each within 0..total, and the engine runs them all: "27 states ratify" falls short; "38 states ratify" passes; "50 states ratify" passes (scenarios-valid)
every number in the title, the stage bodies and the scenario labels appears on a provided page (N-01); scenario yes counts are engine inputs, not page claims (numbers-checkable)
the shape is valid: 1 stage(s) (1-3), 3 scenario(s) (1-3), every total an integer 1-100000, and the fraction sentinels agree with each rule (counts-valid)
